buildCommand: cd landing && npm install && npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); const src='../build/web'; const dst='dist/app'; if(fs.existsSync(src)){ fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true}); fs.readdirSync(src).forEach(f=>{ const s=path.join(src,f),d=path.join(dst,f); if(fs.statSync(s).isDirectory()){ fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true}); fs.readdirSync(s).forEach(c=>fs.copyFileSync(path.join(s,c),path.join(d,c))); }else{ fs.copyFileSync(s,d); } }); console.log('Flutter app copied to /app'); }else{ console.log('No Flutter build found at build/web'); } "
